an6.38:1.1: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an6.38:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2. Ahaṃ
an6.38:1.5: ‘Māhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā,
an6.38:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati:
an6.38:2.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa, atthi ārabbhadhātū' ti?
an6.38:2.5: ‘Yaṃ kho brāhmaṇa ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro, ayaṃ parakāro.
an6.38:3.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa, atthi nikkamadhātu . . . pe . . .
an6.38:3.9: ‘Yaṃ kho brāhmaṇa upakkamadhātuyā sati upakkamavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro, ayaṃ parakāro.
an6.38:4.1: Māhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃvādiṃ evaṃditthiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā,
an6.38:4.2: kathaṃ hi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati:
